item.text: The route is already marked as partially pre-rendered, but the page waits for dashboard data before it renders any page content. That leaves the pre-rendered shell showing only the route loading state. I’m moving the data wait into a Suspense boundary so the dashboard heading and section placeholders can appear in the shell.
